description: Reflection-driven form that edits the scalar properties of a target model object. Named primary fields are shown first, with the remaining properties collapsed under an "Advanced" section, and any property can be excluded when handled elsewhere.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The model object whose scalar properties are edited.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Property names shown above the "Advanced" section, in order.

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Property names to omit (rendered by a dedicated editor elsewhere).

parameters.name: Primary
parameters.description: The model object whose scalar properties are edited.
